steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Both Christianity and Islam teach that men and women are equal in the sight of God, but both traditions have historically assigned different roles to men and women. This tension is a key GCSE RS topic. | RS Exam Tips — Gender Equality and Prejudice: 1. For Gender Equality and Prejudice questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
